import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { acls } from "../../../backend/schema/acls";

export const aclsCms = customizeTable<typeof acls>("acls", {
    display: {
        title: "k"
    },
    fields: {
        k: {
            multiline: true
        },
        v: {
            multiline: true
        },
        domain: {
            multiline: true
        },
        mx: {
            multiline: true
        }
    }
});
